summary.text: Rob Kupec is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 4 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former television meteorologist in Fargo, he says his priorities include agriculture, child care and health care.

paragraphs.text: Rob Kupec was born in Connecticut and lives in Moorhead, Minnesota.
He earned a bachelor's degree in atmospheric science from the State University of New York at Albany in 1992.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working at a coffee company and as a meteorologist, and a 2026 Ballotpedia survey response describes 20 years as a television meteorologist in Fargo.
Kupec took office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Kent Eken.
According to his 2026 survey response, he serves on the Labor, Health and Human Services, and Higher Education committees and is vice chair of the Agriculture Committee.

The response names the Fair Repair Law, a Grain Indemnity Fund and a bill about hospital closures among his biggest legislative accomplishments, and says he has also carried bills on agriculture, child care, health care and rail safety.
